found_by: checker coordinators A and B (wa-key-store, cycle 0), verdicts qa/verdicts/wa-key-store.md (0088da19) and qa/verdicts/wa-key-store.b.md (fa25d74c)
title: A stale held handle's saveCreds overwrites the creds a relink or restore wrote (held is a boolean; the update filter is the owner's live row, not the row the handle loaded)
evidence: src/wa/authState.ts:306, 355. Proposals A-P1 and B-P1 (same finding). Reproduced by A (probe A3, fake and loopback mongod) and B (probe P2): after unlink and a fresh pairing a straggler handle's saveCreds resolves and overwrites the new creds; also for a handle opened before restoreAuthState. Conforms to C3B-C6f as worded; one owner only, so not C3B-C7; the C3A lease is the intended guard. Joint check C3AB-J1 should confirm the unlink order ends the socket first.
fix_direction: Remember the loaded or created row _id on the handle and filter updateOne on it.
